rationale: Rotation typed /clear and bare control words into tmux panes (AISDLC-1107), which reached the enterprise planner as operator input and can press Enter in an open dialog; cli-hierarchy send wrote raw socket lines the harness drops while printing ok. Pick: restore RFC-0058, with the module rotating as code, $.session.send as the only message channel, no false-success send, and a rotation log plus delivery receipt in status (AISDLC-1464), then delete pane /clear once 5 module rotations are logged in real runs (AISDLC-1465, per DEC-0415). Counter-argument: AISDLC-1107 followed a real outage; it survives because that outage came from asking the model to clear itself and from undelivered messages, not from the code-driven clear. Check: no evidence exists yet that the module clear() completes in a live session (no rotation log was ever written); AISDLC-1465's evidence gate verifies it before any pane path is removed. Undefined dependencies: rotation log and delivery receipt, defined by AISDLC-1464.
